title: Stage 10 — protected project saves, source-sheet lifecycle acceptance and a bounded supplier-search contract
platform: Development browser (Vite dev server) · desktop 1280x800 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated agent-browser profiles · no build, installation or native run
summary: Three parallel slices, each adversarially verified by three independent refuters with one repair round. The main project record now refuses stale writes, pauses when another window saves a newer revision and survives quota failures with retry (B-12, B-13, B-02 partial). Source-sheet rename, archive review and recover were exercised against the 13-page Redburn drawing with a locked scale and a real annotation, and the review now lists saved views (D-02, D-04, D-05 partial, verified in development). A server-only, credential-gated Firecrawl v2 search contract with strict response validation and truthful failure states was added to the Cost pane; no live request was made (P-01 dependency-blocked; P-02, P-09, P-10 partial). Full A–Z rows stay open; this is development proof only.
